description: Gap engines identified by analysis but not yet built. Rule: ALWAYS BUILD, NEVER SKIP. Stop-hook enforces.

gaps.name: LatheBirdNestPredictorEngine
gaps.rationale: Continuous-chip wrap risk on rotating workpiece — lathe-specific failure mode.

gaps.name: LathePartingChipClearanceEngine
gaps.rationale: Parting/grooving narrow-deep slot coolant access + chip extraction.

gaps.name: GDTCalloutParserEngine
gaps.rationale: Parse drawing GD&T callouts (feature, symbol, tolerance, datums, material modifiers M/L/F) into structured data. Nothing currently parses raw callout text.

gaps.name: LatheDatumReferenceFrameEngine
gaps.rationale: Build A|B|C datum reference frame for turned parts — typical A=axis, B=face, C=clocking. Decision logic not covered by existing engines.

gaps.name: LatheCoaxialityRunoutValidatorEngine
gaps.rationale: Given coaxial/runout callout, validate achievable TIR from spindle + chuck + deflection stack. Differs from RunoutEffect (tool life) and SpindleRunout (spindle alone).

gaps.name: RoundnessCylindricitySamplingEngine
gaps.rationale: ISO 12181 probe-point sampling plan: number of points, spacing, UPR filter cutoff for given roundness tolerance + method (2-pt, 3-pt vee, rotary).

gaps.name: GageRRMSAEngine
gaps.rationale: Gage R&R / Measurement System Analysis (ANOVA or range method). Operator × part variance decomposition. No MSA engine exists; SPC engines are downstream.

gaps.name: ToleranceBandAllocationEngine
gaps.rationale: Inverse of GDTStackup: given assembly tolerance, allocate across components (equal / cost-weighted / capability-weighted).

gaps.name: FeatureControlFrameValidatorEngine
gaps.rationale: ASME Y14.5 feature control frame syntax validator — catches invalid symbol/modifier combinations (e.g., diameter on flatness, M modifier on form).

gaps.name: ProfileToleranceAnalyzerEngine
gaps.rationale: Profile-of-line / profile-of-surface deviation from basis curve. Lathe-specific: NURBS/parametric profile inspection; not covered by existing engines.
